items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No, I dig Roffco. It wasn't him, but it was somebody.

ctx.x: Are you thinking of Mark Roffco? Were you thinking of him?
No, I dig Roffco. It wasn't him, but it was somebody. It’ll come to me. And this guy, I said "What do those represent?" ... I almost had his name. It’ll come, it’ll come.
